## Rule

**Right-anchored column-parity remap (verified 267/267).** A gray `5` becomes `3`
iff its column index `c` satisfies `c ≡ (W-1) mod 2`, where `W` = grid width.
I.e. the RIGHTMOST occupied column always flips, alternation runs leftward, and
the anchor phase depends on `W` (which varies per example). `0` stays `0`. Only
colors {0,5}→{0,3,5} ever appear; channels 1,2,4,6,7,8,9 are always-zero across
all 267 examples.

> NOTE: the prompt's "perfect-25 / cost ≤1 / identity-transpose" premise is FALSE
> for this task — it is a genuine data-dependent color remap, not identity. The
> zero-param family is dead (see Don't-do). LIVE 80 is at/near the structural floor.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
def solve(g):            # g: R×W grid of 0/5
    W = len(g[0])
    flip_par = (W - 1) % 2
    return [[3 if (v == 5 and c % 2 == flip_par) else v
             for c, v in enumerate(row)] for row in g]
```

## Cost analysis

Cost model (from `neurogolf_utils`): **params** = Σ initializer element counts
(dtype-free) + Constant-node value lengths; **memory** = Σ intermediate-tensor
BYTES (dtype-dependent, max over runs), with tensors literally named `input` /
`output` EXCLUDED. So a fully-fused single op that writes straight to `output`
has memory 0.

LIVE = single Einsum, memory 0, params 80 = `column_basis[2,30]`(60) +
`color[2,10]`(20). The construction is maximally tied: the second `input` copy is
globally reduced to detect W-parity (the right-anchor phase) reusing the same 60
column params, so there is no wasted structure.

Why sub-80 is impossible: (1) any intermediate full plane `[1,1,30,30]` = ≥900 B
>> 80, so multi-node routes are memory-bound (measured 40,365); (2) Conv can't do
positional parity; (3) the Einsum needs two length-30 column rows (ones for
channel-0 passthrough + alternating parity) = 60, and `color` must be `[2,10]` to
align with input's 10 channels = 20 — neither axis shrinks without a charged
Reshape/Slice. 80 is the floor.

  color-perm candidates — all are visible-wrong.
- 2026-07-07 [bo_ng_cld_worker1]: **Multi-node (CumSum/mask/scatter) route is memory-bound → 40,365.** Any
